mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_dataset_versions ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.DatasetUUID}, #{params.Version}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT v.uuid, v.external_id, v.organization_uuid, v.workspace_uuid, v.dataset_uuid, d.external_id AS dataset_external_id, v.version, v.created_at FROM evaluation_dataset_versions AS v JOIN evaluation_datasets AS d ON d.uuid = v.dataset_uuid AND d.organization_uuid = v.organization_uuid AND d.workspace_uuid = v.workspace_uuid WHERE v.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND v.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND v.external_id = #{externalID} AND d.archived_at IS NULL
